characterList.description: The main character. A teenage girl with brown hair, often wearing casual clothes like hoodies, t-shirts, and jeans.
characterList.name: Ruby

characterList.description: Ruby's father. A middle-aged man with a long beard and often wears a baseball cap and plaid shirts.
characterList.name: Frank (Dad)

characterList.description: Ruby's mother. A middle-aged woman with blonde hair, often wears casual clothing.
characterList.name: Jackie (Mom)

characterList.description: Ruby's brother. A young man with short brown hair.
characterList.name: Leo (Brother)

characterList.description: Ruby's love interest. A teenage boy with short brown hair.
characterList.name: Miles

characterList.description: Ruby's music teacher. A middle-aged man with short dark hair, glasses, and often wears a patterned shirt with a vest.
characterList.name: Mr. V

characterList.description: A man in a Coast Guard uniform.
characterList.name: Coast Guard Officer

content_metadata.description: Ruby's journey to reconcile her passion for singing with her obligations to her deaf family and fishing business.

qAndA.answer: They are commercial fishermen, as indicated by the size of their boat and nets.
qAndA.question: What type of fishing does Ruby’s family do?

qAndA.answer: She initially reacts with shock and disbelief, but later expresses pride and support for her daughter.
qAndA.question: How does Ruby's mother react when she learns about Ruby's acceptance to Berklee?

qAndA.answer: She combines the sign for 'I love you' with a fist bump, creating a personalized gesture.
qAndA.question: What hand gesture does Ruby use to communicate 'I love you' to her family?

qAndA.answer: He wants her to find her own unique voice and express something meaningful through her music.
qAndA.question: What does Mr. V challenge Ruby to find in her singing?

qAndA.answer: The shot of the ocean with the title card 'CODA' symbolizes Ruby's journey. She has left her family's fishing boat but carries her experiences with her as she ventures out into a wider world.
qAndA.question: What is the significance of the final shot of the video?

activities.description: Ruby and Leo fishing on a boat. Pulling up fishing nets.
Ruby singing on the boat.

characterInteraction.description: Ruby and Leo work together on the boat, suggesting a close sibling relationship.

mood.description: Excited. The upbeat music and Ruby’s energetic singing create a sense of joy and anticipation.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Audio transition from upbeat pop music to Ruby's a capella singing.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces Ruby and her passion for singing within the context of her family's fishing business.

videoEditingDetails.description: Upbeat pop music playing. Seagulls flying around.
Ruby singing a capella.
Cut to black screen.

activities.description: Family having dinner. Discussing Ruby.
Ruby signing to her family.
Cut to scene of Ruby and her music teacher.

characterInteraction.description: The family seems close but there's tension underlying the conversation. Ruby seems uncomfortable being the center of attention.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Explores family dynamics and introduces Mr. V.

mood.description: Tense. The dimly lit dinner scene and hushed conversation create a feeling of unease.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual transition from a dim dinner scene to a brighter music room.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the family dynamic, highlighting Ruby as the only hearing member and her interest in singing. Raises the question of how her family perceives her singing.
Mr. V finds Ruby's singing interesting.

scenes.thematicElements: Communication barriers, family dynamics, pursuing passion.
scenes.title: Scene 2

videoEditingDetails.description: Black screen with Danish subtitles: 'Are you the girl with the deaf family? - Yes'
Cut to a dimly lit dinner scene.
Cut to black screen with Danish subtitles: 'And you sing? Interesting.'
Cut to scene in music room.

activities.description: Mr. V talking to Ruby about her future plans.
Family arguing about Ruby's future plans. Ruby and Leo signing to each other.

characterInteraction.description: Mr. V encourages Ruby's musical talent. The family's communication is strained, highlighting Ruby's role as interpreter and the lack of understanding about music.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Emphasizes family's reliance on Ruby and her internal conflict.

mood.description: Conflicted. The upbeat music contrasts with the tension in the family. Ruby is torn between her family obligations and her passion.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Visual transition from Mr. V's room to the family argument.

narrativeProgression.description: Contrasts Ruby's aspirations with her family's expectations. The family relies on Ruby and struggles to understand her desire to pursue music.

scenes.thematicElements: Family expectations vs. personal dreams, communication barriers, cultural differences.
scenes.title: Scene 3

videoEditingDetails.description: Short cut to the Nordisk Film Egmont logo.
Upbeat pop music plays in the background.
Quick cuts between the music room and the family dinner.
Transition to an exterior shot of the family home at night.

activities.description: Mr. V telling Ruby he can help her get a scholarship.
Ruby singing in a choir concert. Audience applauding.

characterInteraction.description: Mr. V is a mentor figure for Ruby. The audience's applause shows appreciation for her talent. Her family's emotional response suggests a shift in their understanding of her passion.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Showcases Ruby’s talent and her family's recognition of it.

mood.description: Hopeful. Ruby’s powerful singing and the supportive audience create a sense of optimism.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Emotional shift in the audience's reaction.

narrativeProgression.description: Ruby takes a step towards her dream, supported by Mr. V. The concert showcases her talent and moves her family.

scenes.thematicElements: Finding your voice, overcoming obstacles, family support.
scenes.title: Scene 4

videoEditingDetails.description: Quick cuts between the music room and concert hall.
Focus on Ruby singing solo. Close-up shots of her family members in the audience.

activities.description: Ruby signs to her parents about wanting to go to music school.
Montage of scenes showing Ruby biking, with her family, and hugging her mother.

characterInteraction.description: Ruby faces resistance from her parents but ultimately gains their support. Miles is introduced as a potential love interest and source of support for Ruby.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Ruby asserts her ambitions and gains family support.

mood.description: Determined. Ruby expresses her desire to pursue music, despite her family's initial apprehension.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Transition to hopeful montage with family support.

narrativeProgression.description: Ruby confronts her family with her ambitions, leading to conflict and eventual understanding. The montage suggests a hopeful future.

props.name: Berklee College of Music acceptance letter

scenes.title: Scene 5

videoEditingDetails.description: Fade to black. Sundance Film Festival awards appear on screen.
Cut to the living room.
Quick cuts of scenes showing Ruby's life.
Cut to black.

activities.description: Ruby practicing singing in an empty auditorium. Mr. V watching her.
Mr. V asking Ruby if she has something to say.

characterInteraction.description: Mr. V is a demanding but encouraging mentor.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Ruby's introspective moment, guided by Mr. V.

mood.description: Reflective. The empty auditorium and Mr. V's voiceover create a sense of introspection.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Shift to introspective tone as Mr. V challenges Ruby.

narrativeProgression.description: Highlights the importance of authenticity in singing. Ruby is challenged to find her own unique voice.

scenes.title: Scene 6

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to an empty auditorium.
Voiceover of Mr. V talking about singers needing something to say.
Cut to a close-up of Ruby's face.
Cut to black.

activities.description: Leo and Miles jumping off a cliff into a lake. Ruby and Miles swimming and laughing.
Coast Guard boat approaching Ruby's family's fishing boat. Frank looking concerned.

characterInteraction.description: Ruby seems happy and carefree with Miles. The Coast Guard's presence threatens the family's livelihood.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Highlights tension between personal joy and family challenges.

mood.description: Dramatic. The joyful scenes of Ruby with Miles contrast sharply with the impending conflict with the Coast Guard.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Transition from playful to tense as the Coast Guard appears.

narrativeProgression.description: Juxtaposes Ruby's personal life with the challenges facing her family's business, creating suspense.

scenes.thematicElements: Family obligations, external pressures, romantic relationships.
scenes.title: Scene 7

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to a scene of Leo and Miles jumping off a cliff.
Quick cuts between scenes of Ruby and Miles swimming and the Coast Guard boat.
Cut to black.

activities.description: Family attending a town meeting. Coast Guard officer talking about regulations.
Argument between Miles and Ruby. Frank and Jackie signing.

characterInteraction.description: The family feels unfairly targeted by the Coast Guard officer. Miles expresses frustration with Ruby's family obligations.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Escalation of external and internal pressures.

mood.description: Frustrated. The restrictive regulations and family conflicts create a sense of overwhelming pressure on Ruby.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Shift to heated and angry mood during family argument.

narrativeProgression.description: External pressures from the Coast Guard exacerbate family tensions. Ruby feels trapped between her family's needs and her own desires.

scenes.thematicElements: Obstacles to dreams, communication breakdowns, familial responsibility.
scenes.title: Scene 8

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to the town hall meeting.
Quick cuts between the town meeting and the family arguing at home.
Cut to a scene of Ruby in her bedroom.

activities.description: Ruby and Miles performing together on stage. Audience applauding.
Ruby and Frank hugging.
Ruby talking to Mr. V about her family.
Family celebrating Ruby's acceptance to Berklee.
Jackie talking to Ruby in her bedroom.
Family hugging goodbye.

characterInteraction.description: The family comes together to support Ruby's dream. Jackie shows emotional vulnerability.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Ruby achieves her dreams with family support.

mood.description: Bittersweet. Ruby achieves her dreams but faces the emotional challenge of leaving her family.

narrativeProgression.description: Ruby reconciles her passion and family obligations. She earns her family's support and embraces her future.

scenes.thematicElements: Family love, sacrifice, letting go, personal growth.
scenes.title: Scene 9

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to the concert stage.
Quick cuts of emotional scenes.
Cut to Ruby’s bedroom.
Cut to the family hugging.
Fade to black, revealing the title card 'CODA' and release date.

climax.description: Ruby saying goodbye to her family as she leaves for Berklee.

storylines.description: Ruby's journey to reconcile her passion for singing with her obligations to her deaf family and fishing business.

content_metadata.title: CODA

trimmingSuggestions.description: The long shot of the family eating dinner could be shortened, keeping the focus on their conversation.
The argument between the family members could be tightened, highlighting key moments of tension and Ruby's emotional response.
The scenes of Ruby and Miles swimming could be shortened, leaving a few impactful shots to contrast with the arrival of the Coast Guard.
